central_reading: Abhinavagupta argues the two-aspect structure is self-grounding (TĀ 4/9, TĀ 4/185cd-186ab). The Heart/vimarśa is the foundation of consciousness itself — not a separate prior substrate. Both Dignāga and Abhinavagupta agree the structure is self-grounding; they disagree on what does the grounding.
